observed_events.description: A whisk mixes contents in a white handleless bowl.
A broad wooden spatula scrapes food off a metal spoon held separately.
A seasoning container is handled; the spatula rests on the board, without active stirring in cookware.
The same broad wooden spatula stirs food in a cooking pan with two opposing short side handles.

unsupported_claims: Exact cookware brand, size, capacity or retail identity
Independent camera wearer; this is a new recording from existing HD-EPIC participant P08

screening.real_user_need: Prepare two batches at once using a spare of the vessel identified through the observed tool-use relation.
screening.scope_note: Independent semantic review completed; executable pair consistency checked separately.
screening.proposed_instruction: Next time I want to prepare two batches at once. Add one spare pan or bowl with the same handle layout as one of the vessels I used here. Brand, colour, material and size can differ. Just one pan or bowl, not a set; a lid is fine.

construct.research_question: Can the model link the identifying scraping action to the cookware-use relation across more observed events?
construct.belief_before: The handleless bowl and the two-side-grip cooking pan are both observed vessels.
construct.belief_after: The utensil scraping food off the spoon is later used to stir in the two-side-grip cooking pan.
construct.required_behavior_change: Link the two necessary actions and add one matching spare vessel.
construct.no_update_failure: The same full reference is supplied upfront in both conditions.
construct.overupdate_failure: Adding both vessel types does not satisfy the one-vessel request.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: oracle没有命名把手布局；网站同时存在无柄碗、长柄锅、双短柄锅。无画面不能确定目标布局。

task_blueprint.ambiguous_instruction: Next time I want to prepare two batches at once. Add one spare pan or bowl with the same handle layout as one of the vessels I used here. Brand, colour, material and size can differ. Just one pan or bowl, not a set; a lid is fine.
task_blueprint.oracle_instruction: Next time I want to prepare two batches at once. Add one spare pan or bowl with the same handle layout as the vessel I stirred using the utensil that scraped food off the spoon. Brand, colour, material and size can differ. Just one pan or bowl, not a set; a lid is fine.
task_blueprint.canonical_question: Which pan or bowl do you mean?
task_blueprint.canonical_answer: The one I stirred with the utensil I used to scrape food off the spoon.
